items.title: Canonical Borel equivariant minimal standard support of nonregular Roller boundary points of a Salvetti universal cover
items.difficulty_reason: After the standard Roller boundary, hyperplane separation and Fernos inputs are allowed, the new burden is not the short Borel closed-set subtraction. Lemma2.2 compares the two rays representing a boundary point using eventually persistent labels, finite hyperplane symmetric difference and intersection to obtain a common minimal standard complex. Lemma2.5 constructs B_i and A_i from an infinite nonregular hyperplane chain, stabilizes their finite graph types, passes to the join of Lambda and Lambda-perp, and excludes an escaping hyperplane in two cases. This geometric construction remains substantive independently of the later groupoid applications and the old graph-product orbit-cocycle construction. Count Theorem2.1 and its stabilizer Corollary2.6 as one H2 core.
